rows.text: Step-1:Co-Sift Part Qty. of Micro crystalline cellulose powder (Flocel-101) Spray dried Ph. Eur with Colloidal Silicon Dioxide [Aerosil] through sieve 100# and collect in a separate LDPE bag.
Step-2:Co-Sift remaining Qty. of Micro crystalline cellulose powder (Flocel-101) Spray dried Ph. Eur Maize starch through #60 sieve and collect in a separate LDPE bag.
Step-3:Co-Sift materials of Step-1 and Step-2. with Paracetamol & Microcrystalline cellulose powder (Flocel 102) through #20 sieve and collect in a separate LDPE bag.
Step-4:Sift Hydroxy Propyl Methyl Cellulose (Methocel K100 Premium LV) and Carbomers (Carbopol - 18.0000 G Polymer) through #40 sieve and collect in separate polybag.
Step-6:Mix Talcum of Step-5 and colloidal silicon dioxide (Aerosil) and co-sift through #40 sieve and collect in separate polybag.
Step-7:Sift Magnesium stearate through #60 sieve and collect in separate polybag.
After completion of sifting activity ensure there is no material retain on sieve. □ Complies □ Not Complies

Step-8:Load the dry mix part of Step-3 in RMG and mix for 15 minutes at slow impeller.Speed of Impeller:__________ (limit 1400 to 2000 rpm)Speed of chopper:__________Mixing time:_______________ (Limit: 15 minutes)
Step-9:Take 130.0000 kg of Purified water in SS container.

Step-10:Disperse hydroxy propyl cellulose (HPC_L) in Purified water of Step-9 with continuous stirring to get clear solution (If required pass the binder solution through #40 sieve).stirrer speed: __________
Step-11:Keep aside 20.0000 kg of Purified water as extra vehicle for final stage of granulation.
Step-12:Granulate the dry mix of Step-8 in RMG by using binder solution of Step-10.Binder solution addition time:__________

Step-13:Add binder solution slowly within 1 to 5 minutes with slow impeller speed and chopper off. Carry out kneading of wet mass for 1 to 6 minutes with slow impeller speed and slow chopper speed. Add extra quantity of Purified water from Step-11 (If required) to make the suitable dough mass during granulation and record the extra quantity of purified water & Ampere load at the end of granulation.Kneading time:1 to 5 minutesTotal time for wet granulation process:1 to 5 minutesQuantity of Extra vehicle added:__________Quantity of total added vehicle:__________Ampere load at the end of granulation:__________

text: 5.10 VERIFICATION OF MACHINE AFTER BATCH SETTING:

rows.text: Verification of machine after batch setting:
Verify the machine for removal of scrap / rejection generated during batch setting prior to start of compression.

Frequency: At start and end of the operation, Power failure / Power off or any Breakdown before start of operation. Criteria: metal detector must reject pieces of Ferrous 0.25 mm, Ferrous 0.3 mm, Non-ferrous 0.3 mm, SS 0.4 mm, SS 0.5 mm and pass the blank standard piece.
Angle of discharge of metal detector30° ± 5° (25°-35°)

text: Note: Record the various machine setting parameter of Metal detector with de-duster and observation of metal detector challenge test (Ok / Not Ok) at start and end of the batch and on restart of metal detector after every power off / power failure or any break down.
# For Deduster Set range of Power is 20-40 mv.
During shift start and shift end, challenge test will be performed.

rows.text:
•  During Start up, collect required sample of tablets from chute to perform in-process checks. Record the data on the initial check sheet.
•  If the machine is stopped for reasons like lunch, breaks, or at the end of each day, record the reason.
•  Discard approximately the first five seconds / approx. five rounds of tablets collected as waste upon start/restart of the machine.

•  Following the line clearance, the machine will start.
•  Check the cleanliness of containers before using.
•  In process shall be checked by production & QA as per respective SOP.
•  Machine operator shall withdraw required quantity of tablets at defined time intervals from the outlet of the machine and put them in the pre-labelled container for sampling.
•  In case of machine stoppage during process, reason shall be recorded in the BMR.
•  Weigh the empty container containing double polybag and record the weight in the BMR.
•  Store tablets in container containing double line polybag and sealed with cable tie.

text: 5.16 EVALUATION REPORT OF REJECTION FROM METAL DETECTOR:
Evaluation the total rejection from metal detector as following:
Operator will count the number of total rejects collected at the completion of batch. (1st pass) and record in row “B” below.
The operator will repass individually all rejects from 1st pass through the metal detector second time (2nd pass) and record in row “C” below.
Discard all tablets that passed during the 2nd pass (i.e., no metal detected)
Calculate the percent of metal detector rejects found with the batch as specified in row” “D”.
